9-UNITNING OXIRGI BETI (67-bet).

Yuqorida o'ngda 'A World of Wonders' va TO'Q SARIQ yorliqda oq '9'.

CHAP USTUN:
20) 'Put the verbs in brackets into the correct passive tense, then match the paragraphs to these headings.' Katakchali sarlavhalar: Recommendation, Name/Location/Description, Historical Facts, Things to see/do there.
   MAQOLA (krem fon, yashil skrepka, to'q sariq raqamli xatboshilar 1-4): 'The Little Mermaid 1) ...... (locate) in the Langelinie harbour of Copenhagen and is the national symbol of Denmark. It is a small statue of a mermaid sitting on a rock. Like a real mermaid, she is half human, half fish. [2] The statue 2) ...... (inspire) by a fairy tale by the famous Danish writer Hans Christian Andersen. It 3) ...... (order) by Carl Jacobsen, of the famous Carlsberg Brewery, after he attended a performance of The Little Mermaid by the Royal Danish Ballet Company. The statue 4) ...... (make) by Edvard Eriksen and 5) ...... (put up) at Langelinie on 23rd August, 1913. Sadly, it 6) ...... (damage) many times since then. [3] The Little Mermaid 7) ...... (visit) by more than a million people every year. It 8) ...... (can/see) quite easily from the Langelinie Harbour. Tourists can also enjoy the wonderful harbour view and buy postcards, T-shirts and other souvenirs at the harbour. [4] You will be amazed by this delightful statue, which 9) ...... (should not/miss) by any visitor to the Copenhagen area.'
• Pushti nuqta va to'q sariq 'Vocabulary Revision Game'.
21) 'In teams, use the words/phrases below to make sentences. Each correct sentence gets one point.' Qiya: opening, display, admission, free of charge, was discovered, chapels, were killed, deeply religious, was destroyed, should not be missed, beautiful carvings, was inspired, harbour view, salt was mined
• Katta to'q sariq 'Pronunciation'.
22) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and underline the word stressed, then repeat the sentences.' 1 What was it made of? 2 Who was it written by? 3 How was it discovered? 4 Where were they put? 5 When was it built? 6 Why was it chosen?
• Katta to'q sariq 'Writing' va '(an article about a famous landmark)'.
• TO'Q SARIQ ChIZIQLI QUTI: 'When we write an article about a famous landmark we can divide it into four paragraphs. In the FIRST PARAGRAPH, we write the NAME of the place, WHERE it is and WHAT IT LOOKS LIKE. In the SECOND PARAGRAPH, we write about the HISTORICAL FACTS of the landmark. In the THIRD PARAGRAPH, we write about WHAT VISITORS CAN SEE OR DO there. In the LAST PARAGRAPH, we RECOMMEND a visit to the landmark. We normally use PRESENT tenses to describe the landmark and PAST tenses to write about the historical facts. In this type of writing, the PASSIVE is used when the action is more important than the agent.'

O'NG USTUN:
23) Kasseta belgisi: 'Listen and cross out the inappropriate words, then talk about the Statue of Liberty.' Qaydlar:
   Name/Place/Description: • Statue of Liberty in New York • huge statue of woman holding tablet in left hand and LIGHT/TORCH in right hand • seven points of her CROWN/HAT represent the seven oceans and continents of world
   Historical Facts: • designed by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi • was started in 1876 - was finished in 1884 • made of copper with STEEL/IRON supports • gift to Americans from FINNS/FRENCH to celebrate the 100th anniversary of American Declaration of Independence • statue was made in sections: JUNE/JULY 1885 put into 214 boxes and shipped to New York - reassembled in four WEEKS/MONTHS • declared national monument in 1924
   Things to see/do there: • climb 354 steps to reach the crown, admire the view from 25 BALCONIES/WINDOWS • visit the Statue of Liberty exhibit (museum objects, photographs, prints, videos)
   Recommendation: • amazed by statue - not to be missed
24) 'Use the notes in Ex. 23, and the plan below, to write an article about the Statue of Liberty for a travel magazine (120 - 180 words). You can use the article in Ex. 20 as a model.'
   DAFTAR: Plan - Introduction: Para 1: name, place, description; Main Body: Para 2: historical facts; Para 3: what visitors can see/do there; Conclusion: Para 4: recommendation
• Katta to'q sariq 'Words of Wisdom'. 'Read this sentence. What does it mean?' To'q sariq chiziqli quti: 'If you want a thing done well, do it yourself.'

Bet raqami: pastda o'ngda '67'.

exercises.instructionEn: Put the verbs in brackets into the correct passive tense.
exercises.instructionUz: Qavsdagi fe'llarni to'g'ri majhul zamonga qo'ying.
exercises.explanationUz:
'KIChKINA SUV PARISI' - TO'LIQ
MAQOLA:

  [1] The Little Mermaid IS LOCATED
  in the Langelinie harbour of
  Copenhagen and is the national
  symbol of Denmark. It is a small
  statue of a mermaid sitting on a
  rock. Like a real mermaid, she is
  half human, half fish.
  [2] The statue WAS INSPIRED by a
  fairy tale by the famous Danish
  writer Hans Christian Andersen. It
  WAS ORDERED by Carl Jacobsen, of
  the famous Carlsberg Brewery, after
  he attended a performance of The
  Little Mermaid by the Royal Danish
  Ballet Company. The statue WAS MADE
  by Edvard Eriksen and (WAS) PUT UP
  at Langelinie on 23rd August, 1913.
  Sadly, it HAS BEEN DAMAGED many
  times since then.
  [3] The Little Mermaid IS VISITED
  by more than a million people every
  year. It CAN BE SEEN quite easily
  from the Langelinie Harbour.
  Tourists can also enjoy the
  wonderful harbour view and buy
  postcards, T-shirts and other
  souvenirs at the harbour.
  [4] You will be amazed by this
  delightful statue, which SHOULD NOT
  BE MISSED by any visitor to the
  Copenhagen area.


⚠ ZAMON IShORALARI:

  1 hozir joylashgan → is located
  2-5 tarixiy faktlar → was + 3-shakl
  6 'since then' → has been damaged
  7 'every year' → is visited
  8 'can' → can be seen
  9 'should not' → should not be
    missed


⚠ 'A MERMAID':

  = suv parisi.
  ⚠ 'half human, half fish'.


⚠ 'A FAIRY TALE':

  = ertak.
  ⚠ Hans Christian Andersen - daniyalik
  ertakchi (1805-1875).


⚠ 'A BREWERY':

  = pivo zavodi.
  ⚠ Carlsberg - mashhur daniya
  pivosi.


⚠ 'TO PUT UP':

  = o'rnatmoq (haykal).


⚠ 'DELIGHTFUL':

  = yoqimli, maftunkor.

BEEN damaged.

It 8) ___ (can/see) quite easily from the Langelinie Harbour.

structure.hintUz: New York; woman, tablet, torch, crown
structure.exampleEn: The Statue of Liberty is located in New York. It is a huge statue of a woman holding a tablet in her left hand and a torch in her right hand. The seven points of her crown represent the seven oceans and continents of the world.

The statue was designed by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi. It was started in 1876 and finished in 1884. It is made of copper with iron supports. It was a gift to the Americans from the French to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the American Declaration of Independence. The statue was made in sections; in June 1885 it was put into 214 boxes and shipped to New York, where it was reassembled in four months. It was declared a national monument in 1924.

Visitors can climb 354 steps to reach the crown and admire the view from its 25 windows. They can also visit the Statue of Liberty exhibit, where museum objects, photographs, prints and videos are displayed.
You will be amazed by this magnificent statue, which should not be missed by any visitor to New York.

modelAnswers: The Statue of Liberty is located in New York. It is a huge statue of a woman holding a tablet in her left hand and a torch in her right hand. The seven points of her crown represent the seven oceans and continents of the world.

The statue was designed by Frédéric-Auguste Bartholdi. It was started in 1876 and finished in 1884. It is made of copper with iron supports. It was a gift to the Americans from the French to celebrate the 100th anniversary of the American Declaration of Independence. The statue was made in sections; in June 1885 it was put into 214 boxes and shipped to New York, where it was reassembled in four months. It was declared a national monument in 1924.

Visitors can climb 354 steps to reach the crown and admire the view from its 25 windows. They can also visit the Statue of Liberty exhibit, where museum objects, photographs, prints and videos are displayed.
You will be amazed by this magnificent statue, which should not be missed by any visitor to New York.
modelAnswersUz: Ozodlik haykali Nyu-Yorkda joylashgan. Bu chap qo'lida lavha, o'ng qo'lida mash'ala ushlagan ayolning ulkan haykali. Tojining yetti tishi dunyoning yetti okeani va qit'asini bildiradi.

Haykalni Frederik-Ogyust Bartoldi loyihalagan. U 1876 yilda boshlanib, 1884 yilda tugatilgan. U misdan yasalgan, tayanchlari temirdan. Bu Amerika Mustaqillik deklaratsiyasining 100 yilligini nishonlash uchun fransuzlarning amerikaliklarga sovg'asi edi. Haykal bo'laklarda yasalgan; 1885 yil iyunda 214 qutiga solinib Nyu-Yorkka jo'natilgan va u yerda to'rt oyda qayta yig'ilgan. 1924 yilda milliy yodgorlik deb e'lon qilingan.

Tashrif buyuruvchilar tojga chiqish uchun 354 zinadan ko'tarilib, 25 derazadan manzarani tomosha qilishi mumkin. Ular yana muzey buyumlari, suratlar, bosma asarlar va videolar namoyish qilinadigan Ozodlik haykali ko'rgazmasiga borishi mumkin.
Bu ulug'vor haykaldan hayratga tushasiz - Nyu-Yorkka kelgan har qanday tashrif buyuruvchi uni o'tkazib yubormasligi kerak.

items.en: If you want a thing done well, do it yourself.
items.uz: Ish yaxshi bajarilishini xohlasang, o'zing qil.
items.answerEn: It means that you can only be sure something will be done properly if you do it yourself, rather than relying on others.
items.answerUz: Ya'ni ish to'g'ri bajarilishiga faqat o'zing qilsanggina ishonch hosil qila olasan, boshqalarga tayanmasdan. (O'zbekchada: 'O'z qo'ling - o'z qo'ling'.)
